battle.name: 第四次反法同盟
battle.brief: 第四次反法同盟期間，1806年10月，普魯士軍在奧爾施泰特迎戰法軍並遭敗北。交戰中，線列步兵仍以燧發槍（Flintlock musket）射擊，再配合刺刀近戰；此役為普法戰爭的重要戰鬥。

kit.name: 燧發槍
kit.history: 擊錘打火比火繩穩。線性列陣的射速和精度都靠它撐著。

countries: 本記錄所稱第四次反法同盟1806年戰役，是指普魯士王國在俄羅斯帝國、大不列顛王國與瑞典王國配合下，對法蘭西帝國及其萊茵邦聯盟國所進行的首輪大陸戰役。主戰線自法軍越過萊茵河、進入中德諸邦開始，經耶拿與奧爾施泰特兩場會戰，追擊普軍殘部，最後寫至十二月底主要要塞與政治安排的變化。俄軍在波羅的海沿岸集結，英國以海軍、補貼金與少量遠征軍牽制法國，瑞典軍則在波美拉尼亞作戰；直接承擔主戰的是普魯士野戰軍。法軍侵入普魯士的部隊連同預備隊通常估計約十八萬人，分為七個軍及一個預備隊，薩克斯、巴伐利亞與符騰堡等邦國另可提供小型分遣隊。普軍總兵力因徵集程度、戰區分配與點名資料而有不同估算，常見重建值約為二十五萬人，卻分屬不同翼隊、支隊與要塞守軍。此記錄只把1806年普魯士戰場視為第四次同盟戰爭的一個部分，不把英國海戰或俄國在1807年的戰鬥混入同一場會戰。
countriesEn: This record treats the 1806 campaign of the Fourth Coalition as the opening continental phase fought by the Kingdom of Prussia with support from the Russian Empire, Great Britain, and Sweden against the French Empire and its allies in the Confederation of the Rhine. The main theater begins when French armies cross the Rhine and enter the central German states, continues through the Battles of Jena and Auerstedt and the pursuit of the broken Prussian forces, and extends through the principal fortress surrenders and political settlements at the end of December. Russian armies were assembling along the Baltic coast, Britain was applying naval pressure, subsidies, and a limited expeditionary force, and Swedish troops were operating in Pomerania, but the Prussian field army bore the burden of the immediate land war. The French force invading Prussia, including its reserve, is commonly estimated at about 180,000 men organized into seven corps and a reserve, while Saxony, Bavaria, Württemberg, and other confederated states could provide smaller contingents. Estimates of the Prussian total vary with mobilization, theater allocation, and the quality of surviving returns; a common reconstruction gives roughly 250,000 men divided among wings, detached columns, and fortress garrisons. This account treats the Prussian theater as one part of the wider Coalition war and does not merge British naval operations or Russian battles from 1807 into the 1806 campaign.
people: 法軍最高指揮由拿破崙直接掌握。他計畫讓達武的第三軍、貝納多特的第一軍、內伊的第六軍、奧熱羅的第七軍與蘇爾特的第四軍從不同道路進入圖林根，再由拉納率領預備隊策應；穆拉率的騎兵擔任外側掩護，莫爾捷則負責向北施壓並監視斯特拉爾松方向。達武原定向奧爾施泰特與耶拿之間行軍，從班貝格經科堡、埃爾福特前往克滕，得知普軍右翼集中在奧爾施泰特後立即轉向。他把古丁、弗里安與庫爾丹三個師分列，沒有等待主力抵達。普軍國王弗里德里希·威廉三世在奧爾施泰特親自掌握右翼，不倫瑞克公爵弗爾德里希·威廉與軍隊同在並多次發動攻擊；公軍受傷後仍被抬離戰場，十一月初去世。耶拿方面由薩克斯-威瑪公爵卡爾·奧古斯特指揮左翼，面對多路法軍。路易·斐迪南親王在十月十日施雷肯施泰因附近的戰鬥中陣亡，迫使追擊中的法軍回身應戰。霍恩洛在格賴茨附近投降，齊岑在哈爾勒投降。布呂歇爾當時率領加入瑞典軍序列的普軍支隊，沒有回到普魯士主力戰場。
peopleEn: Overall command of the French army remained with Napoleon. His plan was to move Davout's III Corps, Bernadotte's I Corps, Ney's VI Corps, Augereau's VII Corps, and Soult's IV Corps through separate routes into Thuringia, with Lannes and the reserve following to support whichever wing was engaged. Murat's cavalry screened the outer approaches, while Mortier operated farther north and kept pressure on the Stralsund direction. Davout was marching from Bamberg through Coburg and Erfurt toward Köthen when intelligence placed the Prussian right wing at Auerstedt. He turned toward the threat and deployed the divisions of Gudin, Friant, and Gourdin without waiting for the rest of the French army. King Frederick William III personally directed the Prussian right at Auerstedt, where Duke Frederick William of Brunswick fought alongside the army and repeatedly launched attacks before suffering the wound that ended his active command; he died of those injuries in early November. At Jena, Duke Carl August of Saxe-Weimar commanded the exposed Prussian left against several French columns. Prince Louis Ferdinand was killed at the fighting near Schreckenstein on 10 October during the pursuit. Hohenlohe surrendered near Greiz, and Ziesen capitulated at Halle. Blücher was at this time commanding a Prussian brigade incorporated into Swedish service rather than returning to the main Prussian field army.
kits: 1806年的裝備並非決定戰役的空洞口號。普軍步兵主要使用1797年列裝的普魯士Zündnadelgewehr步槍，配置刺刀與胸前彈藥盒；不同團的深藍色外套、彩色衣領和軍帽可協助辨識營伍。法軍步兵普遍使用1791年Charleville式步槍，同樣配刺刀與定量攜帶的紙包彈藥，並穿著深藍色白色翻領的線列制服及1801式軍帽。炮兵方面，法軍各師可配備Gribeauval twelve-pounder野戰炮以及較輕的四磅或六磅炮，普軍則使用三磅、五磅與七磅炮。槍炮本身只是系統的一部分：前裝藥包、炮尾、炮架與炮車構成完整重裝，炮兵連還須攜帶前車與馬匹。戰鬥消耗的步槍彈藥由營連彈藥盒供應，炮彈與火藥則由師屬炮兵公園和後勤車隊補充。軍團補給縱列攜帶糧食、飼料、備用馬匹與修理材料，道路與宿營地點決定車隊能否跟上。普軍的1797式步槍和火炮仍具射擊能力，敗因不在武器突然失效。奧爾施泰特大批火砲雖被奪取，若缺少炮車、炮手或馬匹，法軍也不能立即把每一門炮投入追擊。
kitsEn: The equipment available in 1806 must be understood as functioning systems rather than as decorative slogans. Prussian infantry primarily carried the Prussian Zündnadelgewehr musket adopted in 1797, together with bayonets and individual cartridge boxes. Dark blue coats, colored facings, and military caps allowed units to be distinguished on the field. French infantry generally carried the Charleville Model 1791 musket, also with a bayonet and a fixed allowance of loose ammunition carried in the soldier's pouch, and wore dark blue coats with white facings and caps associated with the 1801 pattern. French artillery formations possessed Gribeauval twelve-pounder field guns as well as lighter four- and six-pounder pieces, while Prussian batteries included three-, five-, and seven-pounder guns. The gun formed only one part of the system: the charge, projectile, carriage, limber, and horse team had to remain together. Infantry ammunition came from battalion and brigade cartridge supplies, while artillery powder and shot traveled with divisional parks and wagon trains. Corps supply columns carried food, forage, spare horses, and repair materials, and their movement depended heavily on roads and suitable bivouacs. Prussian muskets and artillery remained effective; the defeat did not result from the sudden failure of their weapons. Although many guns fell into French hands at Auerstedt, captured pieces lacking crews, limbers, or horses could not all be employed immediately during the pursuit.
tactics: 拿破崙沒有把全軍投入一次正面衝撞，而是以數個軍從南面、東南面與中央山地平行推進，利用分兵後仍能互相策應的距離，使普軍無法判斷主力所在。達武的第三軍沿班貝格、科堡、埃爾福特至克滕的北上道路行軍，其任務是保護柏林、阻止不倫瑞克公爵與耶拿左翼會合，並在必要時向拿破崙靠攏。十四日清晨，他得知奧爾施泰特已有普軍後部署三個師：古丁師承受最早出現的密集縱隊，弗里安師位於中央，庫爾丹師控制另一側道路與村落。普軍先以炮兵和步兵連續攻擊古丁師，後來投入大量騎兵衝擊密集步兵；法軍以近距離步槍火力及霰彈反制，並等普軍力量離開原有位置後由弗里安師向縱隊側翼施壓。達武始終保留本軍後方控制權，因此沒有像普軍縱隊那樣被局部突破牽動全軍。耶拿的問題則在地理與指揮分離。薩克斯-威瑪公爵麾下各師由不同道路和村莊進入戰場，難以迅速集中；內伊、奥熱羅與拉納相繼到達，蘇爾特又經格拉向耶拿側後逼近。各路法軍不必先消滅整支普軍，只需切斷其師級聯繫、退路和指揮中心。普軍陣線一旦被分成數個戰鬥群，炮兵雖多，也缺乏統一射擊目標。
tacticsEn: Napoleon did not send the entire army into one frontal collision. He advanced several corps in parallel from the south, southeast, and central uplands, preserving enough lateral distance for mutual support and preventing the Prussians from identifying the main French effort. Davout's III Corps moved north along the axis from Bamberg through Coburg and Erfurt toward Köchten, with the tasks of protecting Berlin, preventing the Duke of Brunswick from joining the Jena wing, and moving toward Napoleon when required. On the morning of the 14th, intelligence showed that the Prussian right was at Auerstedt. Davout deployed three divisions: Gudin met the earliest dense Prussian columns, Friant occupied the center, and Gourdin controlled the roads and villages on the other side. Prussian artillery and infantry initially pressed Gudin, and a large cavalry force later charged the closely formed French infantry. French musketry and canister fire answered the assault, and Friant attacked the exposed sides of Prussian columns after they had moved away from their original positions. By retaining control behind his own line, Davout avoided the disruption suffered when a Prussian local defeat drew the rest of the army into the fight. At Jena, geography and separated command were decisive. Divisions under the Duke of Saxe-Weimar entered by different roads and through different villages and could not concentrate quickly. Ney, Augereau, and Lannes arrived successively, while Soult approached from Gera and threatened the Prussian rear and flank. French units did not need to destroy the entire Prussian army simultaneously; they had to sever its connections, retreat routes, and command center. Once the Prussian position fragmented into separate combat groups, even its numerous guns lacked coordinated targets.
data: 九月八日，普魯士要求法軍離開安斯巴赫，並就法軍通過薩克斯控制區提出警告；九月九日，普魯士宣戰，法軍越過萊茵河並向圖林根與易北河上游展開。十四日清晨，法軍先後在耶拿和奧爾施泰特接戰。奧爾施泰特方面，常見重建值列法軍約五萬一千人、普軍約五萬三千人，火炮約七十四門對一百一十五門；耶拿方向的法軍則常列為八萬至十萬人，普軍左翼約五萬上下。這些是依作戰命令、補充報告與各師番號作出的估計，不是同日逐名點名。戰役失敗後，耶拿的普軍向北撤退，奧爾施泰特的國王與參謀人員則设法重整仍可控制的部隊；法軍沒有立即摧毀所有普軍單位，但奪取了大量火炮、彈藥、車輛與軍需品。十月十日，路易·斐迪南親王在施雷肯施泰因附近陣亡；十月十一日，霍恩洛在格賴茲投降；十月十七日，齊岑在哈爾勒投降。拿破崙於十月二十七日進入柏林，莫爾捷對斯特林的封鎖則迫使守軍於十月三十一日投降。十一月十九日，法軍攻擊但澤的外圍堡壘，至十一月二十九日守軍投降，港口與大量存貨落入法軍控制。十二月十四日，普魯士在柯尼斯堡接受法方提出的初步政治與領土安排，正式和平條款仍留待1807年處理。十二月底，東普魯士政府仍從柯尼斯堡運作，庫斯特林則繼續抵抗至翌年；因此一八〇六年的勝負已經確定，整場第四次同盟戰爭卻尚未結束。
dataEn: On 8 September, Prussia demanded that French troops leave Ansbach and warned France over the movement of troops through territory controlled by Saxony. Prussia declared war on 9 September as French forces crossed the Rhine and advanced into Thuringia and the upper Elbe region. The armies first engaged at Jena and Auerstedt on the morning of the 14th. Common reconstructions for Auerstedt give roughly 51,000 French and 53,000 Prussians, with approximately 74 French guns against 115 Prussian guns. The French force committed at Jena is more often estimated at between 80,000 and 100,000 men, against a Prussian left wing of about 50,000. These figures are estimates derived from orders, scattered strength returns, and unit assignments rather than simultaneous individual musters. After the defeats, the Prussians at Jena retreated north, while the king and staff at Auerstedt gathered whatever forces they could still control. The French did not instantly destroy every Prussian unit, but they captured large quantities of artillery, ammunition, wagons, and supply stores. Prince Louis Ferdinand was killed near Schreckenstein on 10 October. Hohenlohe surrendered near Greiz on the 11th, and Ziesen capitulated at Halle on the 17th. Napoleon entered Berlin on 27 October, while Mortier's pressure against Stettin forced its garrison to surrender on the 31st. On 19 November French troops attacked the outer defenses of Danzig, whose garrison capitulated on 29 November, surrendering the port and its large stocks. On 14 December Prussia accepted French political and territorial proposals at Königsberg, although the definitive settlement remained unfinished. At the end of December the East Prussian government still operated from Königsberg, while Küstrin continued to resist into the following year. The military decision of 1806 was therefore settled, but the Fourth Coalition war itself was not over.
cause: 直接原因出現在普魯士、法國與薩克斯之間的權力衝突，但背景可追溯到第三次同盟戰爭結束。1805年的普雷斯堡和約重新安排中歐，使奧地利喪失對薩克斯與西里西亞的關鍵影響，法國則把巴伐利亞、符騰堡與薩克斯納入萊茵邦聯。普魯士沒有加入法國主導的新秩序，仍保持形式上的獨立；同年它又與拿破崙建立軍事合作，讓法軍取得穿越部分普魯士領土的便利，並接受法國以巴伐利亞占區交換而來的安排。英國補貼與俄國的外交支持提高了普魯士的安全感，國王也擔心法軍控制北德後會迫使普魯士加入邦聯。1806年夏，邦聯實際運作後，安斯巴赫法軍、薩克斯徵兵與普軍調動的問題同時惡化。普魯士要求法軍退出安斯巴赫，法軍則把薩克斯拒絕配合普方視為敵對行為。拿破崙不打算讓普軍逐區完成動員，因為一旦普軍完成集中，法軍將面對俄國可能加入的全面戰爭。他因此選擇在普魯士指揮系統尚未接合時發動進攻，以消滅野戰軍、奪取柏林，並切斷北德各要塞之間的相互支援。
causeEn: The immediate crisis arose from a conflict among Prussia, France, and Saxony, but its background reached back to the end of the Third Coalition. The Peace of Pressburg in 1805 reshaped central Europe, deprived Austria of decisive influence over Saxony and Silesia, and placed Bavaria, Württemberg, and Saxony within the French-led Confederation of the Rhine. Prussia did not join that new settlement and formally retained its independence. At the same time, it entered a military understanding with Napoleon that gave French troops convenient passage through parts of Prussian territory in return for arrangements involving the Bavarian occupation. British subsidies and Russian diplomatic support increased Prussian confidence, while the king feared that French domination of northern Germany would force Prussia into the Confederation. During the summer of 1806, disputes over French troops at Ansbach, Saxon mobilization, and Prussian movements worsened at the same time. Prussia demanded a French evacuation from Ansbach, while France treated Saxony's refusal to cooperate with Prussia as a hostile act. Napoleon could not afford to allow Prussian mobilization to complete, because a concentrated Prussian army would have to be fought alongside the possible entry of Russia. He chose to attack while Prussian command connections were still incomplete, aiming to destroy the field army, seize Berlin, and sever the mutual support of the northern fortresses.
impact: 耶拿與奧爾施泰特最直接的後果，是普魯士野戰指揮系統失去縱深。兩翼不僅在戰場上分斷，此後也無法互相掩護；國王只帶少量核心單位退向東普魯士，不倫瑞克公爵受傷去世，霍恩洛、齊岑等指揮官相繼投降或失去參謀位置。大量火砲與軍需被奪取，使法軍在向北追擊時能以本國兵站和炮兵公園補充彈藥，而普軍重建則依賴仍能保持聯絡的師、旅與要塞。戰役也讓法國付出實際延伸成本。巴黎到柏林的道路線變長，斯特拉爾松、但澤與庫斯特林仍需兵力和攻城器材，法軍必須從主力分出莫爾捷等部隊，因而難以同時追擊普軍殘部、監視瑞典軍並全速準備對俄戰爭。政治上，萊茵邦聯在秋季進一步重組，十月成立北德邦聯，普魯士被排除於外；英國失去一個能在德國正面投入野戰軍的大陸盟伴，瑞典仍被波美拉尼亞戰事牽制。俄國雖未在1806年進入德國境內作戰，其動員與外交準備反而因普軍敗北而變得更重要。普魯士的步槍、炮兵和訓練並未在一夜間失去價值，真正改變戰局的是指揮分散、各師行軍速度不一、資訊到達較晚，以及道路縱隊無法在預定時間集中。
impactEn: The most immediate effect of Jena and Auerstedt was the destruction of operational depth in the Prussian command system. The two wings were not merely separated on the battlefield; afterward they could no longer cover one another. The king withdrew east with only the units he could still rally. The Duke of Brunswick died from his wounds, while commanders including Hohenlohe and Ziesen surrendered or lost their positions in the chain of command. Large quantities of guns and supply stores passed to the French, allowing French troops moving north to replenish ammunition from their own depots and artillery parks, while the Prussians could rebuild only through units, brigades, and fortresses that remained in contact. The victory also imposed real costs on France by extending its lines. The route from Paris to Berlin lengthened, while Stralsund, Danzig, and Küstrin continued to require troops and siege equipment. Units such as Mortier's had to be detached from the main army, limiting France's ability to pursue Prussian remnants, contain Swedish forces, and prepare at full speed for Russia. Politically, the Confederation of the Rhine was reorganized during the autumn and the North German Confederation was established in October without Prussia. Britain had lost its principal continental partner capable of committing a major field army, while Swedish forces remained occupied in Pomerania. Russia did not fight inside Germany in 1806, but the Prussian defeat made Russian mobilization and diplomatic preparation more important. Prussian muskets, artillery, and training did not become worthless overnight. The factors that changed the outcome were dispersed command, unequal marching speeds, late arrival of information, and columns on inadequate roads that could not reach their assigned positions on time.
result: 截至1806年十二月底，拿破崙已取得決定性的戰役勝利。普魯士在奧爾施泰特與耶拿投入的主力不再保有集結能力，不倫瑞克公爵與路易·斐迪南親王戰死，薩克斯-威瑪公爵受傷並被俘，霍恩洛與齊岑所部相繼失聯或投降。法軍占領柏林、哈爾勒與斯特林，並迫使但澤投降，使普魯士西部的交通節點、港口和主要軍用庫存大多脫離王國控制；國王與中央機構則退到柯尼斯堡維持東普魯士政府。十二月十四日的柯尼斯堡安排表明，普魯士短期內已不能以獨立盟員身分繼續德國戰場行動，但最終和約尚未簽訂，庫斯特林也未被攻下。因此一八〇六年終止的是普軍重新集結的希望，而不是整個第四次同盟。英國與俄國繼續對法國作戰，最後到1807年7月7日的蒂爾西特和約才正式確定新的歐洲安排。傷亡總數不列單一數字，因為死傷、被俘、失聯、逃亡及日後歸隊在各軍記錄中分法不一，部分戰鬥報告又在中轉與俘獲時遺失。本文只保留可核對的指揮官損失、火炮繳獲、部隊投降及日期，不以無法確定的精確傷亡數製造完整感。
resultEn: By the end of 1806, Napoleon had achieved a decisive operational victory. The main body of the Prussian army committed at Auerstedt and Jena could no longer reassemble as an effective force. The Duke of Brunswick and Prince Louis Ferdinand were killed, the Duke of Saxe-Weimar was wounded and captured, and troops under Hohenlohe and Ziesen lost contact or surrendered. French forces occupied Berlin, Halle, and Stettin, while the surrender of Danzig removed Prussian control of major communications, the Baltic port, and extensive military stores. The king and central institutions withdrew to Königsberg to continue governing East Prussia. The arrangements concluded at Königsberg on 14 December showed that Prussia could no longer act as an independent coalition member in the German theater, but peace had not yet been finalized and Küstrin remained in Prussian hands. Thus the end of 1806 marked the collapse of the Prussian army's ability to reconcentrate, not the end of the entire Fourth Coalition. Britain and Russia continued the war, and the final European settlement was not established until the Treaty of Tilsit on 7 July 1807. This account does not give a single exact casualty total. Records classify killed, wounded, captured, missing, deserted, and later returning soldiers differently, and some reports were lost while units moved or prisoners were processed. It therefore limits itself to command losses, captured guns, documented surrenders, and reliable dates rather than presenting uncertain casualty figures as exact.
